speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL). The combination of severe anemia and thrombocytopenia with a markedly elevated white blood cell count, alongside the specific finding of promyelocytes with Auer rods (pink, needle-shaped inclusions) on the smear, is pathognomonic for this condition. Given the high risk of life-threatening coagulopathy, I recommend immediate initiation of ATRA (all-trans retinoic acid) and urgent coagulation profile testing.
